title: Dahab gibbatih addat aggiriqqe sinni kataysa
intro: kaxxa nabiyyih silaalak, rooci qangor kee imaan doorimteh ten monumental farmo cattuh. Tama muuci, ummatta diggalsimak sugte wak, monotheism (monotheism) wagsiisak, sissin qaynatih taqabitte wagsiisak, sissin qaynatih taqabitte wagsiisak, sissin qaynatih taqabitte wagsiisak, sissin qaynatih taqabitte kataasak sugte. Nabiyyi ummattah taqabi wagsiisak yuduureh yan waqdi, ta ximmo kalali qande hinnay dirki kee baxsi bohoy kinni. Ta Yallih diggale taama abeena miyyaay?
clues: Anu Yalli dooreh sugem gersi marih xaqut tan dirkih, yi doori qokol kee maysaxxagak sugte.
Anu yabti qaddos yomcowweeh, caylale zulmih foocal farmoyti lih gexe.
Lafale safar uddur, farmoyti qale dubuk tawqeeh, sinam dacrisuh yoo cabe.
ken raqti, ummatta dahab muuci bicisseeh, anu ken xaaqimeh amaanat luk sugeenim, takkay immay oson yi fayitte cineenih.
farmoyti naqabu kee rooka kibbiimeh yuduure wak, anu yibbixe, takkay immay anu baxxaaqiseh anu cayla luk sugem kee ken fanat sittin way kataaseleemih meysi.
Anu Muusa xaqut soole nabiyyi, yi toobokoyta, kay quuka tasgallem kee asnaamah saduh digga luk raqte.

trial.label: Gibbatu/Tekkooka
options: Sinam maabitina tanim takkay immay dahab ruga yaaqubeenih
Anu inni magaalak diiriyimeh suge ascossih
trial.answer: Sinam maabitina tanim takkay immay dahab ruga yaaqubeenih

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Anu currik yewqeeh, inni nabiyyi farmot bisoh axce
Miraacisuh qusba agat yoo yomcowweh suge.
outcome.answer: Anu currik yewqeeh, inni nabiyyi farmot bisoh axce

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant. (25:35)
